title: Resolve native capture output root before changing application directories
body: The capture helper accepts the relative path .tmp/baseline-captures, creates it in the caller directory, then passes that relative path to applications launched after cd into each runtime directory; the app writes elsewhere and the helper fails its output checks. Passing an absolute output root works. Canonicalize the output root once before changing directories and use that path for both app env and postconditions.

title: Expose progress while native capture logs are redirected
body: The native capture helper redirects each application stdout and stderr to a log and emits nothing while the app runs. The live box queue classified the long capture as idle and returned status 75 even though the editor had written its complete frames and deinitialized; wrapping the helper in a queued shell that prints a heartbeat every 15 seconds completed with exit 0. Have the canonical capture helper surface periodic child progress or queue-visible heartbeats.

title: RenderGraph editor document fixtures need an explicit VoxelDocument link
body: The dispatched serialized-layer regression needed EditorDocumentModel::Load and Flatten in test_editor_document_render.cpp, but test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_gpurender2 linked SVO and not VoxelDocument. I had to add a conditional VoxelDocument target link in the critical-nodes CMake manifest to compile the editor-model fixture. Include this dependency through shared RenderGraph test-target composition or dependency discovery so a fixture can exercise the real editor model without per-target wiring.

title: Isolate the runtime cache for native capture byte witnesses
body: The standard native captures loaded the shared build/wsl/runtime-cache and reported 9 shader hits with no misses; the HUD PNGs differed from wave by 4,694 pixels. Re-running the same apps with VIXEN_CACHE_DIR set to a new worktree-local cache reported 0 hits and 9 misses, and all three HUD PNGs became byte-identical to wave. The editor PNGs did not change. This correlation is not yet a proven shader defect, but capture byte witnesses need an explicit isolated cache root and recorded cache telemetry so unrelated persistent runtime state cannot change outputs.

title: CodegenTool fixture tests should resolve their Undertow schema root
body: The CodegenTool fixture NoSavedLinksNeedsNoContentBinding fails unless the caller manually sets UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow. Declare or provision this test input in the fixture runner so the kernel suite works from a standard checkout.
